title: Emperor Yu founds the Xia dynasty of China
summary: Emperor Yu founds the Xia dynasty of China
description: Record first created by the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024)). CFAH dates it as well (added by the CFAH pass); the sort follows the four-tier rule.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 1: CFAH anchor point: 2197 BC (AP-4). Sort changed by the CFAH pass (2026-10-18): was provisional (Generations) 2197 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 2: Founding of the Nations," ARJ 15 (2022): 405–426, section "Anchor Points", Table 3 "Anchor points of ancient history found in this paper" (AP-4 "Chinese Xia Dyn.", 2197, Liu Xin); also "Duration 13: The Reign of Yu of China: 2197 BC"
chronologies.note: Table 3 prints the year as "2197" under "Year BC" (source: Liu Xin, Xia 1,421 years before the 776 BC eclipse). CFAH-2 gives an error of ± 3 years. The OSF preprint CFAH-17 later revises Yu's accession to 2192/2191 BC (AP-94).

chronologies.citation: Preparing the World for Jesus (2nd ed., 2024), ch. 5 "The Babel Rebellion", PDF p. 99 (printed p. 85)
chronologies.note: China's first king, Emperor Yu; also p. 157. p. 125 prints "2198 BC".
